vo.text: Inside the pad, alternating current flows through this coil.
vo.speak: Inside the pad, alternating current flows through this coil.

vo.text: That makes the magnetic field expand and collapse.

vo.text: Now place a second coil inside that changing field.
vo.speak: Now place a second coil inside that changing field.

vo.text: The field induces a voltage in the second coil.

vo.text: The coils do not touch. They are magnetically linked.

vo.text: The phone then rectifies and regulates that power for its battery.

vo.text: Move the coils apart or off-center.

vo.text: Wireless charging is energy crossing a changing magnetic field between two coils.
